description: CC0 3D asset packs for the battle grid, characters and dungeon. Fetch with `node scripts/assets-fetch.mjs` (downloads into assets/_packs/, copies into assets/models/). Both folders are gitignored; this manifest is committed.
styleNote: KayKit (characters, skeletons, weapons, dungeon) and Quaternius (monsters, animals) are both chunky, cute low-poly styles with flat/gradient colours, so they sit together on one grid. KayKit models are ~1 unit = 1 m (characters ~2 m tall with big heads); Quaternius models need per-role normalisation by bounding box.
notes: All chosen packs are CC0 1.0. Per-file downloads come from the authors' own distribution points: KayKit's official GitHub repositories and the models Quaternius uploaded to Poly Pizza under his own account. No zip extraction or itch.io click-through is needed.

License watch: on 2026-08-28 quaternius.com introduced the Quaternius Asset License (QAL v1.0) for new releases (e.g. Bestiary). The packs used here are still labelled CC0 on their quaternius.com pages and on Poly Pizza; CC0 dedications are irrevocable, and QAL section 7 says changes do not apply retroactively. Re-check before adding any newer Quaternius pack.

Roles: {file} is a path under assets/models; {node} names a mesh inside that file (e.g. a helmet or cape to show/hide or clone onto another character). KayKit characters and skeletons share one rig with handslot.l / handslot.r / head bones for attaching weapons, shields and helmets.

Monster models: first matching monsterRules[].match (regex on the SRD monster id) wins, else monsterStandIns[creatureType]. Final scale = sizeScale[size] * (rule.scale ?? 1); tint multiplies material colour.
